purpose: Persistent later-human-review inventory for owner-authorized narrow empty/zero/trivial-object qualifications in mathDef Wave 2. Proposals are NOT applied edits.

review_candidates.object_and_ambient_scope: Finite free modules R^m,R^n over a commutative ring with identity, including R=0 under Stacks Algebra convention.
review_candidates.existing_stored_formulation: For a homomorphism φ:R^m→R^n of finite free modules, its rank is the largest integer r for which the induced exterior-power map ∧^rφ is nonzero (and is zero when φ itself is zero).
review_candidates.counterexample: For R=0 all finite free R-modules and maps vanish. Even the zeroth exterior-power map id_R is the zero map, so the set of r≥0 with ∧^rφ nonzero is empty and its maximum is undefined.
review_candidates.minimal_qualification_to_review: Explicitly treat a zero map, including every map over R=0, as having rank 0; use the maximal nonzero exterior-power characterization only when that set is nonempty. Preserve the zero ring in the ambient algebraic universe.
review_candidates.alternative_restriction_not_preferred: Globally assume R≠0, which discards an otherwise permitted degenerate case.
review_candidates.source_attribution_limitation: This is a mathematical repair proposal, not a claim that the current Stacks provider explicitly enacted this override in the printed maximum clause or that archived snapshots were certified.
